items.reason: Gap 0 describes two concurrent deliveries of the same event both passing the Set check before either records it, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 1 says the key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that a validly signed body replayed with a different header bypasses deduplication.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds never reach it.
No gap depends on multiple processes or instances; gap 0 concerns workers within the one in-process queue.
